guide.overview:
Makes stdout the sole delivery channel for code-review findings: the reviewer prints delimited XML, the orchestrator extracts it and writes `review/round-<n>/review.xml`, and failed rounds persist the captured transcript to `reviewer-output.txt`. Start with `src/skill-scripts/code-review.ts` — it owns extraction, the write, validation, and transcript handling; then read the reviewer prompt and tests that lock the contract.
```mermaid graph LR reviewer[Reviewer harness] -->|stdout delimited XML| capture[dispatchReview capture] capture --> extract[_extractReviewDocument] extract --> write[Orchestrator writes review.xml] write --> validate[validateAgainstSchema] extract -->|no valid document| transcript[reviewer-output.txt] ```

group.name: Core change
group.rationale: The orchestrator implementation that replaces dual-channel file/stdout delivery with print-only extraction, canonical writes, and diagnostic transcripts.

file.description: Always extracts findings from captured stdout, writes review.xml itself, persists reviewer-output.txt on non-certifying rounds, and clears stale artifacts before re-dispatch.
Clarifies that review dispatch alone captures stdout because it is the sole findings-delivery channel.

group.name: Reviewer contract
group.rationale: The instructions the external reviewer receives; they must match the extractor and prompt builder in the core module.

file.description: Removes on-disk write instructions and makes printing the delimited findings document the only delivery path.

group.name: Tests
group.rationale: Integration coverage for extraction, schema validation, transcript persistence, and stale-artifact cleanup under the single-channel model.

file.description: Renames and extends the delivery suite with noisy-transcript extraction, transcript-on-failure behavior, and re-run stale-transcript removal; drops the old disk-precedence case.

group.name: Documentation
group.rationale: User-facing prose aligned with the new stdout-only delivery and reviewer-output.txt diagnostics.
